title: 2019 AIAA SciTech presentation, slides 4 to 9

tellings.quote: look into the the slide presentation that I presented at the 2019 AIAA Scitec.

plain: The Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, whose patents have been compared to UFO technology, tells Michels that anyone who wants to understand his ideas should look at the slides he presented in 2019 at SciTech, a yearly conference of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics. He points to those slides, numbers 4 to 9, as where his case is laid out, though on the show he does not go through what they say.
